primary.name: Piers Garthwaite
primary.title: Head of Web, Paddle (London)

evidence.what_it_shows: Ashby posting (published 2026-10-29, department Commercial, team Marketing, location UK, remote): 'Reporting to the Head of Web'. Names no person.

Google snippet for a RocketReach page (rocketreach.co/piers-garthwaite-email_10138222): 'Piers Garthwaite, based in London, GB, is currently a Head of Web at Paddle', with earlier roles at Deloitte and Mews. This is a data-broker snippet, not a first-party source.

Google snippet for LinkedIn result 'Piers Garthwaite - Paddle': London, current experience Paddle, University of Leeds, 790+ followers. The snippet shows the employer but not the title. Profile page not opened.

Paddle advertised a Head of Web role (owning paddle.com strategy, roadmap and conversion, and leading a design/dev/UX/content/experimentation team). Kindred Capital's job board (jobs.kindredcapital.vc/.../56179591-head-of-web) marks it 'no longer accepting applications', and the role is no longer on Paddle's live Ashby board. Consistent with the role having been filled.

A Piers Garthwaite was formerly Head of Marketing at Kriya Finance (formerly MarketInvoice). A Behance web-designer profile with a MarketInvoice role also appeared in search. These are probably the same person and fit a web/marketing background, but that is not confirmed.
